summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching its earnings press release for the quarter and nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. Reported third-quarter net revenues of $19.4 million and net income attributable to controlling shareholders of $6.9 million, or $2.43 basic and $2.39 diluted EPS, with adjusted EBITDA of $11.3 million across an average of 11.0 owned vessels. The filing discloses roughly $5.8 million used to repurchase 358,130 shares under a $10 million plan and a new ~$37.0 million Kamsarmax newbuilding order for 2029 delivery. This is a routine periodic earnings release, not a special situation.
